title: BEST FREE FL1CK SCRIPT
features:
Flick features list:
* Aimbot / Aimlock
* Smooth aimlock with adjustable speed
* Nearest player / nearest mouse targeting
* Custom aim part (head / torso / feet)
* FOV-based aimlock with visible circle
* Rainbow FOV support
* Wall check (visibility check)
* Ignore shielded players
* Ignore lobby players
* Aimlock offsets (x / y fine-tuning)
* Aimlock on specific selected player
* Player prioritization system
* Player ignore list
* Auto-fire (experimental / WIP)
* Adjustable auto-fire delay and shoot delay
* ESP (name, distance, weapon display)
* Outline / highlight ESP
* Tracers (top / middle / bottom origin)
* Skeleton ESP
* Shielded-player detection & coloring
* Fully customizable ESP colors
* Rainbow ESP / outline / tracers / skeleton
* Adjustable ESP text size
* Adjustable outline transparency & fill transparency
* WalkSpeed modifier
* No-velocity (freeze enemy movement)
* Bunny hop with adjustable delay
* X-Ray with adjustable transparency
* FullBright
* No fog
* Custom camera FOV
* Auto respawn
* Auto lobby / auto play buttons
* Knife auto-switch when close to enemy
* Adjustable knife range
* Knife range visualizer
* Mass open knife crates
* Mass open gun crates
* RGB gun / knife effects
* RGB material or highlight mode
* RGB neon force mode
* RGB async sync system
* Adjustable RGB speed & reapply speed
* Custom hit sound effect
* Custom critical hit sound effect
* Auto-apply custom SFX
* Custom toggle size & visibility
* Menu keybind support
* DPI scaling
* Theme & config saving
* Custom cursor
* Notification side control
And more!
